explanation: The eraser was attached to the end of a pencil. A picked up the pencil by its eraser end and used the pencil tip to write a message on the blank sheet.
The eraser was on the end of a pencil. A picked up that pencil and wrote the message on the blank sheet with its writing tip.
The eraser plugged the refill opening of a mechanical pencil that had run out of lead. A pulled the eraser off, put in a new lead, and then used the pencil to write the message on the blank sheet.
